text:
ana: Heads-up: enterprise customer asked for per-route cost breakdown + lightweight trace hooks in Console. They want a clear way to map SLO regressions to $ impact and to run postmortems. I sketched scope and launch checks below. Feedback?

praveen: Quick note  we add hooks we must keep dataplane overhead <10% and avoid sync I/O. Plan: sampling before serialization, small proto envelope, async WAL.

joan: Product constraints: RBAC on cost views (billing vs eng), exportable CSV for finance, and PII redaction + KMS tagging for Private installs. These are blockers for GA for any regulated customer.

ana: (typo  meant ana) Proposed minimal MVP surface:
- route-level token meter (top-N routes)
- cost-per-1k-tokens calc by model variant
- adaptive trace hooks: sample errors + anomalies + small baseline rate
- dashboard template: route slice + cost trend + error overlay
- RBAC & export + redaction toggle for Private

sasha: Storage policy suggestion: full traces kept 14 days, indexed aggregates 90 days. Default sampling: 0.05% global, route overrides allowed. Need compression/dedupe on traces.

praveen: Draft sampling snippet we can expose in Console:
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.0005  # 0.05%
  routes:
    "/v1/generate": 0.005
    "/v1/chat": 0.001
  rules:
    on_error: 1.0
    on_cost_anomaly: 1.0
```
This keeps volume low and guarantees errors/anomalies are captured.

mike: Canary plan idea: staged rollout 5% x 48h -> 20% x 72h -> GA. Monitor p50/p95, cost-per-1k, error-rate. Success thresholds: latency regressions <5% p95, error-rate uplift <0.2pp, cost variance <15%. If any breach, auto rollback.

joan: Economics: product proposes target telemetry budget +12% infra spend first quarter; hard stop +25% needs exec approval. If canary observes >18% bump we pause. Engineering: we need a precise storage delta to tune retention.

sasha: Engineering asks: provide expected event sizes and QPS to run sims. Also confirm whether route-level attribution includes embeddings and system tokens. That affects cost math.

ana: Attribution rules: include prompt+response tokens, GPU time estimate normalized per model family, and network IO estimate (small). We'll publish a clear formula in Console docs.

praveen: Implementation notes: do per-request cheap delta compute (tokens + model multiplier) and emit compact envelope to WAL ahead of heavy trace marshal. Use per-tenant batching to S3-like blob store and async indexer.

mike: I'll prototype the canary dashboard and alert rules. Will add a temporary view that shows route -> cost-per-1k, p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and sampled traces link.

observability-bot: created GH issue #4621 "console: per-route cost + trace hooks: MVP scope + canary plan" and assigned to @ana @praveen @mike. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/4621

joan: Prioritization: this is a customer-driven enterprise ask. Recommend P0 next quarter and include customer vignette in PRD.

ana: Next actions:
- Mike: dashboard + alert proto (due Tue)
- Praveen: perf sim & proto envelope spec (due Wed)
- Sasha: storage-cost model + retention plan (due Fri)
- Joan: RBAC/export/redaction checklist + vignette (due 5 days)
I'll schedule a 30m follow-up after artifacts land. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
